project.name: MusicFree 视觉升级
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Music player mobile app UI, Spotify-inspired dark theme with bold green accent, vibrant gradients, rounded cards, youthful and modern feel. Chinese music app context.

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Dark base #0a0a0a, green brand #1DB954, vibrant gradients on action cards, white text on dark, secondary text #b3b3b3
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: Rounded cards with 12px radius, pill-shaped buttons and tabs, 8px radius on list items, circular album art
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Circular Std / PingFang SC, bold display titles 2.5rem, semitone headlines, body 0.875rem, uppercase tracking on captions
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: 16px base padding, 24px section gaps, 12px item gaps, 8px component internal spacing
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: Gradient action cards, frosted-glass mini player bar, pill tab switcher, round icon buttons, list items with press feedback
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Dark layered surfaces #0a0a0a / #141414 / #1a1a1a, subtle borders rgba(255,255,255,0.08), no glow effects, depth via surface layering only
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: Square rounded album covers, filled outline icons, gradient overlays on cards
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: Press scale feedback on list items and buttons, smooth transitions 200ms, spring animations on nav

sharedProjectShellContract.typeStack: Circular Std, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: Three-tier dark surfaces with subtle border separation, no shadows on static elements
sharedProjectShellContract.navigationModel: Bottom tab bar with pill active indicator, mini player bar above tabs
sharedProjectShellContract.CTAStyle: Bold green (#1DB954) pill buttons with white text
